tasks.statement_en: Find all solutions of the equation $2\cos^2x-5\sin x-4=0$ belonging to the interval $\langle 0,2\pi\rangle$. [Card value is the sum of all solutions, in radians.]
tasks.notes: Solutions are 7pi/6 and 11pi/6; their sum is 3pi.

tasks.summary_pl: Kwadrat bok $1$; $CE=2DF=2x$. Dla jakiego $x$ pole $AEF$ min.?
tasks.statement_en: Square ABCD has side length 1. Points E and F are chosen on sides BC and CD respectively so that |CE| = 2|DF|. Let x = |DF|. Find the value of x for which the area of triangle AEF is smallest.

tasks.topic_pl: Twierdzenie o reszcie z dzielenia wielomianu
tasks.statement_en: Find the values of coefficients a and b of the polynomial W(x) = x^3 + a*x^2 + b*x + 1, given that W(2) = 7 and that the remainder from dividing W(x) by (x-3) equals 10. [Card value is a + b.]
Numbers a, b, c are such that the sequence (a,b,c) is arithmetic with a+c=10, while the sequence (a+1, b+4, c+19) is geometric. Find these numbers.
tasks.notes: Two valid triples exist: (2,5,8) and (26,5,-16); card value sums all six numbers across both triples (not explicitly covered by the annotation rules for a two-alternative full solution). [verified: exclude: Two valid triples; a+b+c=15 for each (trivially fixed by b=5, a+c=10), all-summed 30. Solver may give 15 or 30.]
Wyznacz m, dla ktorych x^2+mx+2=0 ma dwa rozne pierwiastki o sumie kwadratow > m^2-13/2; m in (-3,-2sqrt2) u (2sqrt2,3).

tasks.statement_en: Point A=(-2,5) is a vertex of isosceles triangle ABC with |AC|=|BC|. The area of this triangle equals 15. Side BC lies on the line y = x+1. Compute the coordinates of vertex C.
tasks.notes: Two valid points exist: C=(5,6) and C=(-3,-2); card value sums all four coordinates across both points. [verified: exclude: Two valid vertices C (key). Task implies one C, summary has no sum hint; solver may give 11, -5 or 6: which-one/all ambiguity.]
Wykaz, ze pole trojkata ABC jest wieksze lub rowne 2 (proof via AM-GM inequality).
Udowodnij, ze AC=FG (przystawanie trojkatow zbudowanych na bokach rownolegloboku).

tasks.statement_en: We roll a symmetric six-sided die three times. Compute the probability that the sum of the squares of the three rolled numbers is divisible by 3.
